verdict.detail: 15 products, 15 in Amazon's top 20 for the filters, 15 with their rating right

answer:
First 15 non-sponsored results, in Amazon's order. The filters were Aluminum, Adjustable, 4 Stars & Up and $25–$60, sorted by Best Sellers. That left 158 results. Sponsored cards are skipped. Two items (N86 and tounee) also appeared again as sponsored ads further down; I used their organic listings.

Correction to line 15: the link is https://www.amazon.com/dp/B09LHKM4SY. I mistyped the ASIN in the URL.

Recommendation: #1, the Lamicall (B08M94BTYC), at $29.99.
- It's an aluminum riser whose name lists MacBook Pro compatibility, so it suits a 14" MacBook Pro.
- It has 4.7 stars across 10,562 ratings, so the score rests on a lot of reviews. It was also the top Best Seller in this filtered set.
- It costs $29.99, near the low end of the $25–$60 range. The N86, tounee, Nulaxy and UGREEN stands cost $5–$25 more with similar ratings.
- The vertical holders (OMOTON dual, UGREEN 3-slot, HumanCentric) hold a laptop closed on its edge rather than raising it for use. They are a different kind of product, so I didn't pick one.

I only read the search-results page. I didn't open the product pages to check the exact angle and height range or the weight capacity. Check those if you need a specific viewing height.

Recommendation: #1, the Lamicall (B08M94BTYC), at $29.99.
- It's an aluminum riser whose name lists MacBook Pro compatibility, so it suits a 14" MacBook Pro.
- It has 4.7 stars across 10,562 ratings, so the score rests on a lot of reviews. It was also the top Best Seller in this filtered set.
- It costs $29.99, near the low end of the $25–$60 range. The N86, tounee, Nulaxy and UGREEN stands cost $5–$25 more with similar ratings.
- The vertical holders (OMOTON dual, UGREEN 3-slot, HumanCentric) hold a laptop closed on its edge rather than raising it for use. They are a different kind of product, so I didn't pick one.

I only read the search-results page. I didn't open the product pages to check the exact angle and height range or the weight capacity. Check those if you need a specific viewing height.
